summary: Model updated for the NEWLEADER/startup change; harness rebased; 8 fresh traces validated; model checking found two update-path defects (ACK before fsync; stale in-memory database after a failure in the new INITIAL window) leading to loss of a committed transaction.
validation_limits: Model-checking runs are budget-limited (30 min per run) unless a log reports natural completion; recorded as LIMITED_COVERAGE, not proof.
Trace.tla replays the update window and SyncRequestProcessor/apply path through base Actions; election/discovery and leader-side broadcast probes remain the inherited observed projection.
TRUNC synchronization is not exercised by any harness scenario; real fail-stop crashes are not exercised (in-JVM restarts only).
Part 4 reproduction/confirmation was not executed in this task; findings carry MC and real-trace evidence only.
The specular CLI (ci-result, findings lookup/record) is not installed; generated CI reports were not produced.
CR-1 (liveness) is not modeled; the NewLeaderAckMismatch probe never fired in the collected runs.

findings.title: NEWLEADER ACK is written before the DIFF-synchronized transactions are durable
findings.cause: Learner.syncWithLeader hands buffered proposals to logRequest (enqueue only) and writes the NEWLEADER ACK without waiting for the SyncRequestProcessor flush.
findings.trigger: Re-elected leader DIFF-syncs a transaction that only it has logged; the learner ACKs NEWLEADER and the leader activates; the learner crashes before its SyncThread forces the transaction.
findings.consequence: The leader activates and serves a history that is durable only on itself; after the learner's crash a later leader activates without the committed transaction.

findings.title: Learner failing between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE keeps a stale in-memory database; a later leader activates without committed transactions
findings.cause: startupWithoutServing leaves the learner in State.INITIAL; a failure before UPTODATE skips shutdown (no drain, no fastForwardDataBase), so votes and a new leader's history come from an in-memory database lacking the DIFF transactions.
findings.trigger: Learner ACKs NEWLEADER, old leader activates, learner fails before UPTODATE; learners elect one of themselves while the old leader is down or partitioned.
findings.consequence: The new leader activates the next epoch without a transaction that was committed and client-visible in the previous epoch.

findings.title: Proposal ACK from the SyncThread can precede the NEWLEADER ACK and be taken as the NEWLEADER ACK
findings.cause: Since the update starts the SyncRequestProcessor before the NEWLEADER ACK, SendAckRequestProcessor may write ACK(proposal zxid) first; LearnerHandler treats the first ACK as the NEWLEADER ACK and waitForNewLeaderAck rejects the mismatched zxid without counting the learner.
findings.trigger: Fast fsync of a DIFF proposal on the learner's SyncThread before the learner thread writes ACK(NEWLEADER).
findings.consequence: The learner is missing from the NEWLEADER quorum; the leader may time out and abandon the epoch (availability), not a safety violation.
